pages.text: Ancient Guards, Forgotten Transports, and Ancient Commanders remain bound to newly generated ruins in The Slimic. Guards patrol and attack players and companions. Creative and Spectator players and fellow remnants are excluded.

Carriers resist when attacked and move goods between their own ruin’s two Slime Chests. Opening a chest removes its ancient transport link. Commanders alert guards of the same ruin to nearby intruders.

Pursuit ends 24 blocks from the ruin’s center. Escape the boundary and the remnant returns home. Defeating one yourself or with a companion guarantees one core and one seal, subject to normal mob loot rules and events.
